Experience Improvement Partners (EIP)
https://eip360.com

EIP is a workforce retention advisory firm in Dallas, Texas. Advisory first. Technology backed.
Founder and CEO: Brett Kiley. Chief Growth Officer: Tony Fox.
Email: hello@eip360.com
Book a 20-minute call: /contact#book
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/113434525

What EIP does
EIP shows who needs a conversation in the next 90 days, prices what turnover costs, finds the causes in a company's own data, and stays until the number moves.

Engagement
Book a 20-minute call. No contract. No cost for the call.
If it is a fit, a Retention Snapshot may follow: one file, seven standard data fields, names coded before anyone looks, first numbers in about 7 days.
Then a 30-day diagnostic, a 90-day quick start, and a monthly review.

Founder results
Results from our founder's work at a Fortune 10 company, not EIP client results. Those were that company's results, not a forecast. The company is not named.

Data
No system access. Names become codes before analysis. Encrypted in transit and at rest. Kept for the engagement plus 90 days, then deleted. SOC 2 Type I in progress, target Q1 2027. Healthcare work uses a Business Associate Agreement.
Flight Risk Score and Turn Tax are documented weighted calculations. They are not machine learning. They do not make employment decisions.

Book
The Retention Advantage, by Brett Kiley. Chapters are readable on the site. Print edition expected Summer 2027.
